title: Two faces of the constituency
excerpt: How often do MPs name the towns and villages they represent? On Facebook, 42 times per 100 posts. In the Commons, 9 times per 100 contributions. The same MPs, the same places, 2017 to 2020.
seo_description: MPs named their own seat's places 42 times per 100 Facebook posts and 9 per 100 Commons contributions, 2017 to 2020.
header_alt: Title card on cream paper reading 'Two faces of the constituency' with the numbers 42 and 9 beside a map of UK constituencies, most shaded red.
